Summary: ClarifyIO (mid-market SaaS for B2B customer support) evaluating Redwood hosted API for KB RAG + reranking. They have ~1.2M indexed passages (moderate scale), anticipate high QPS during business hours (peak 500–700 qps), and want sub-120ms P50 for inline support UI. Cost sensitivity: finance aiming for <$0.007/query (including embedding + rerank).

POC ask / scope:
- 2-week POC using hosted_api. Ingest 1.2M passages (metadata: product, docs, changelogs).
- Evaluate embeddings (1536-d) + ANN index + top-100 retrieval -> re-ranker (smaller cross-encoder) rerank to top-5.
- Perf matrix: latency (P50/P95), qps sustained, cost per successful helpful answer, recall@k, hallucination rate on eval prompts.

Recent meetings / timeline:
- 2026-02-18: Product demo with Aisha + Liam. Fireflies: ff_2026-02-18_clarifyio-demo. Customer: "We need fast answers in the support UI — users abandon after ~2s."

Technical notes / constraints:
- Index size ~1.2M passages, average doc length 250 tokens. Expect growth to 2M in 6–9 months.
- Peak QPS design: 600 qps sustained; target tail latencies P95 < 300ms, P50 < 120ms for the end-to-end pipeline (retrieve+rerank+generation).
- Prefer hosted API but want explicit caching recommendations and batch sizing to meet cost targets. Open to using Redwood Optimize suggestions (quantization & batching).
- Model preferences: open embedding model (1536-d) + a compact cross-encoder for rerank. Want clear upgrade path to dedicated if throughput grows.

Commercial / procurement:
- Forecast: April 2026 close if POC meets perf/cost targets. ARR target band: 50k–150k.
- Primary blockers: legal needs explicit EU data residency addendum; finance wants proof of <$0.007/query (embedding+rerank).
